note: WYGWYL world views grouped into the districts of Atlantis: measured palettes (body: what it is made of; glow: what it lights with), architecture, key places, moments, the poems each holds, and where it lands on the movie map’s city

districts.name: Naraka Market
districts.where: the nightlife district (2089, 1891), around The Severn and its fire escapes
districts.eras: harbor → docks → warehouses → the Fall → clubs under neon → the twilight market
districts.mood: twilight that never ends · humid, crowded, devotional, improvised · someone else’s rain
districts.arch: shipping containers stacked two to four high into shops and rooms; corrugated awnings; cable webs and string lights across the street; AC units; stair alleys climbing between walls; the underpass flooded into a shadow-pool; a teahouse breathing vapor
districts.materials: rusted teal and turquoise steel, painted plywood, wet asphalt as a mirror
key: the Underpass Shadow-Pool, where children stand in the reflection (92–93)
moments: the club crowd dissolving in warm haze (36)
poems: 01 Out of Life — his high-rise room in The Severn above the market, dusk into night
14 Hot Minute — the harbor party, the haze that takes him
07 DJ Turn Me Up borrows its crowd (36)

districts.name: The Orange Haze
districts.where: the industrial district (2621, 2146) and the highway ring
districts.eras: field → mills → factories → the Fall (the fire) → ruins kept as a park → the haze that never lifted
districts.mood: oppressive scale, heat, solitude · one figure on a bridge · the Fall’s air still burning
districts.arch: elevated concrete catwalks with glowing kerb strips; expressway undercrofts of pillars and stairs; brutalist slabs and a line of smokestacks; skyways through smog; a sodium tunnel stair with a single chair
districts.materials: raw concrete, rust, soot; sodium light that colours everything
key: the Orange Catwalk, an elevated walk along the expressways (84, 85)
moments: a lone walker on the skyway (80, 81)
shadow play beneath the solar bridges by day (77)
poems: 10 Magic Ride — the motorcycle through tunnel light toward dawn: the undercroft and the skyway
districts.signature: any hour, but always the haze: dense orange fog, sodium glow, silhouettes

districts.name: The Hive
districts.where: the downtown district (1463, 1824): the New Boroughs’ towers
districts.eras: field → … → the towers of the New Boroughs (“a language made exact”) → darkened in the Fall → still standing, lit by signal
districts.mood: grandeur and dread · density · vertigo looking up · beacons blinking like a nervous system
districts.arch: dense slab towers and gothic needle spires; lattice signal towers with red and blue beacons; a megastructure atrium
districts.materials: dark glass, steel lattice, wet concrete
moments: the city of needles burning seen from above (70)
poems: 01 Out of Life — the high-rise, the haze, then cloud and total black
02 Flashing Lights — black space with lights flashing: the beacons
districts.signature: night · mist · cold blue with pulsing red

districts.name: The Overseer
districts.where: the rowhouses district (2099, 1179), the northern edge facing the mountains
districts.eras: rowhouses → … → the Overseer’s quarter, the old order’s watch
districts.mood: cold watchfulness · symmetry · the moon · sterile indigo
districts.arch: blue industrial pipework among towers; the old palace roofless under the moon; a canyon of slabs framing the moon; a glass skywalk over the indigo city
districts.materials: glass, painted steel pipe, pale render gone blue
key: the mirrored skyline of blue and red (25)
moments: the moon standing in the slot between towers (88)
poems: 02 Flashing Lights — the winter-night flashback, headlights raking a dark room
districts.signature: moonlit · clear · cold; the one warm colour is an alarm crimson

districts.name: Mirror Thread Bay
districts.realm: B and C · the harbor and the shore
districts.where: the waterfront district (1469, 2345) and the south shore
districts.eras: shore → fishing → harbor → harbor → flooded (the Fall) → promenade → the bay of mirrors
districts.mood: reflection, memory, tenderness · drowned rooms remembered · handprints on glass
districts.arch: turquoise lagoons with garden islands; boardwalks under the great bridge; flooded colonnades and atria with bioluminescent floors; submerged corridors; the oil-slick canal under the radio bridge; the sleep-dam wall with words
districts.materials: water above all; concrete under water; moss; glass
moments: handprints on the glass of a drowned corridor (57)
the canal under the radio bridge at night (63)
poems: 13 How to Win My Heart — the daylight harbor walk to the corner café (23, 24)
04 Nevermore — the shore at twilight, calm waves
03 How to Break off an Engagement — the storm and its aftermath: the flooded corridors
districts.signature: night bioluminescence / daytime turquoise · water first

districts.name: Cortex Commons
districts.where: the old town district (1036, 2130): the cathedral square “too large for it”
districts.eras: the old center’s square → … → the commons that listens
districts.mood: communal, civic, joyful · children running · the city listening to the sky
districts.arch: radio-telescope dishes set in the squares (WYGWYL radio, made civic); a sunken oculus forum; a mosaic canopy over the crowd; a misted square of glowing cubes; the cathedral among glass towers under the moon
districts.materials: pale stone, wet paving painted with light, mosaic
moments: children running across the light-painted square under a dish (16)
poems: no poem lives here: it is where the city listens to them

districts.name: The Light Gate & Atlantis Central Plaza
districts.where: the gates (realm A) and the site of 06 (5120, 3540)
districts.eras: the field of stones (the Shore) → … → the Light Gates open (Resurrection)
districts.arch: a perimeter of transparent, high-frequency fences of light that becomes the gate; beyond it a circular plaza ringed by rose terraces; a hall of crystal trees over a mirror pool
districts.materials: light itself at the gate; rose stone; crystal; still water
moments: the gate’s glare on wet ground (90)
poems: 06 Resurrecting Atlantis — he sees the entrance, goes in through the gates
districts.signature: still night · the gate’s white glare

districts.name: Ankhu Spires
districts.where: the high ground of realm A (the forest at 5280, 3640, h 101 m; the mountains at 5180, 3940, h 127 m)
districts.eras: the lone peak → … → the high city, grown in Resurrection
districts.mood: altitude, breath, mist · gardens in the air · domestic life at height (laundry under the stars)
districts.arch: coral and terracotta spires with carved arches, a souk at their feet; mushroom-cap platforms on slender stems with hanging gardens; planter-pillars with trees above the cloud; sky bridges and observation decks; glass spires among palms; the Spire Elevator Shaft, a hundred-storey red core; laundry lines on the roofs
districts.materials: terracotta, coral render, pale steel, glass, living green
key: the floating domes over the water (9)
moments: looking down through the glass filament (99)
poems: 08 Newly Single — the open-air rooftop club, the city glowing blue and pink below (28, 31, 11)
05 Bloodline — the night garden becomes the gardens in the air
04 Nevermore — the field below the spires
districts.signature: blue-hour mist · violet underlights at night

districts.name: Cenotaph Rail
districts.realm: B → A → C · the rail along the spines
districts.where: rises at the ruin field (2107, 3201) and runs along the spines, the poet’s own routes between the realms
districts.eras: field → village → quarter → ruins (the Fall) → ruins walked as a monument → the rail that carries the names
districts.mood: elegy, transit, height, rust · a figure at the railing above the mist
districts.arch: rusted platforms high above the city; viaduct arches carved with names (the cenotaph); wet stone steps down to the lake under the mountain; a platform in orange haze; a platform where the city dissolves into pixels
districts.materials: rusted steel, carved stone, wet granite
moments: a cleaning drone’s last memory, the city coming apart (98)
poems: 11 New Day — dawn: he rides back to the shore, the ruins, mist on the sea (97)
every journey between the realms: the spines

districts.name: The Shrouded Arcade
districts.eras: suburb → consumer district → abandoned → the arcade of screens
districts.mood: spectacle and its ruin · a memory corridor · chrome and static
districts.arch: an abandoned mall with its escalators still lit; the LED canyon crossroads, a screen canopy of galaxies over an avenue; a neon memory corridor in red and blue; chrome doors in neon alleys
districts.materials: chrome, LED skin, wet tile, dead shopfronts
moments: the street soaked in someone else’s rain (100)
poems: 09 Yet Heard — the sidewalk crowd, neon, the moon in the puddles (62, 100)
02 Flashing Lights and 10 Magic Ride pass under the canopy (94)

districts.name: The White Temple & its Pools
districts.where: the chapel / white temple on the south shore (the site of 12, 3422, 4181)
districts.eras: the chapel on the tidal flat → loses its roof and bell in the Fall → the white temple on its ruins
districts.mood: stillness, return · warm hall light · decades compressed
districts.arch: a white portico across a reflecting pool among trees; a mirror-pool hall framing the night skyline; the Reflecting Pool Mouth holding the stars
districts.materials: white stone, still water, warm interior light
moments: the stars held in the pool (72)
poems: 12 Reunion — the hall in warm light, the grounds at twilight, the lit porch
11 and 13 begin here

districts.name: The Ascent
districts.where: the sky, the moon and the void: the vertical moments, not a district
districts.mood: the ancestors, the gifts, the soul leaving · the whole city seen at once
districts.arch: organic cosmic arches over a parade; the city as a blue crystal seen from above; the moon; the milky way over the spires; blue flowers over the night city; red ground under a single spotlight; the reconstructed skyline across the water
key: the milky way over the spires (41)
moments: he enters the Ancestors’ parade, receiving cosmic gifts (68)
his soul rising, seeing Atlantis whole (69)
poems: 05 Bloodline — the gifts are stars and galaxies (68)
14 Hot Minute — floating in black (69, 67)
the film’s overture and credits: the Powers-of-Ten descent and rise are this view (69)

poems.title: How to Break off an Engagement
